title: Surgeon
description:
About Avis Hospitals: 
 Avis Hospitals is India's first and only chain of Vascular and Interventional Radiology Hospitals, specializing in minimally invasive vascular treatments and varicose vein care. Minimally invasive procedures are at the core of our treatment approach, focusing on quick recovery, minimal pain, and same-day discharge procedures. 
 Role Overview: 
 We are looking for passionate surgeons interested in developing expertise in minimally invasive vascular procedures and vein care. The selected candidate will work closely with experienced vascular specialists and gain exposure to advanced laser and minimally invasive vascular treatment techniques. 
 Key Responsibilities: Evaluate and manage patients with vascular and vein-related conditions Assist and perform minimally invasive vascular procedures under guidance Participate in patient consultations and follow-up care Maintain accurate medical records and treatment documentation Collaborate with the clinical team to ensure quality patient care Follow clinical protocols and patient safety standards 
 Eligibility Criteria Mandatory Qualification: MBBS with MS/DNB in General Surgery Valid NMC/State Medical Council Registration 
 Preferred: Exposure to General Surgery, Minimal Access Surgery, or related surgical specialties Interest in minimally invasive vascular procedures Good communication and patient management skills 
 Desired Skills: Strong clinical and diagnostic abilities Basic surgical and OT exposure Willingness to learn minimally invasive vascular procedures Team-oriented and patient-centric approach Ability to work in a fast-paced healthcare environment 
 Why Join Avis Hospitals? Opportunity to work in a specialized vascular care setup Exposure to minimally invasive and laser-based vascular treatments Structured training and mentorship Career growth in vascular and interventional care Work with experienced vascular specialists 
 Locations: Kolkata / New Delhi / Pune
Employment Type: Full-Time
 Travel Requirement: Candidates must be willing to travel across Avis Hospitals locations as required.
 Salary: 
• During Training Period: 1,00,000 per month
• Post Training: 2,00,000 per month 
 Interested candidates may apply directly or share their updated CV. Immediate joiners preferred.

Key Skills: Laparoscopic Surgery,General Surgery,Laparoscopy,General,Surgery
